law.catch_line: (For contingent effective date, see Acts 2025, cc. 91 and 109, cl. 2) Limitation on use of name of systems
law.text: The use of the terms "Virginia Coordinate System of 1927," "Virginia Coordinate System of 1983," or " Virginia Coordinate System of 2022" on any map, report of survey, or other document shall be limited to coordinates based on the Virginia coordinate systems as defined in this chapter.
